description_full: OBIC Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides system integration, system support, and office automation services in Japan. It offers consulting and system planning, system design and analysis, program development, implementation and operational support, network security design, and other related solutions for various industries, as well as OBIC7, an enterprise resource planning solution; and education and training support services. The company also engages in the sale of personal computers, communication equipment, and other system peripherals, as well as office furniture; office planning and interior construction; network support; and business package software. It serves chemistry, steel, machinery and manufacturer, food, distribution and retail, trading company, logistics, real estate, construction work, information technology and media, finance, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

financial_summary: Obic Co. Ltd. is a large-cap technology business with a $16.4B market cap on $853M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +7% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 23% against a 8% cost of capital — a 15-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 78% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $451M in free cash flow — roughly 53 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, with adequate 0.98× cash conversion.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.5% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and within its sector the business captures 2.8× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
